reason: Claim c1 was tested exhaustively: probe t6 ran kernel.run on all 63488 finite FP16 bit patterns (the complete legal input domain per problem.txt, including both signed zeros, subnormals, and ±65504) on the real GPU, comparing FP32 outputs against the FP64 real-arithmetic rho = sqrt(1+x^2)-1 on exact stored values. Result: 0 violations of abs(err) <= 1e-8 + 1e-5*|rho|; worst margin (err - tol) = -1e-8; max absolute error 3.05e-4 occurs at large |x| where the tolerance is 0.655. The kernel computes the algebraically equivalent x²/(√(1+x²)+1) in FP32, and the contract explicitly permits algebraic rewrites and intermediate rounding within tolerance. Since the legal domain is exactly the finite FP16 set and every element was checked, the contract is satisfied throughout.
